title: My Family's Looks
text: I want to tell you about my family. My dad is tall and strong. My mom is short and pretty. My big brother is thin, and people say he is handsome. My baby sister is very cute. We all look different, but we are a happy family!

questions.question: What is the dad like?
questions.source_sentence: My dad is tall and strong.

questions.question: What is the mom like?
questions.source_sentence: My mom is short and pretty.

questions.question: What is the baby sister like?
questions.source_sentence: My baby sister is very cute.
